description: Preview payroll for a household employee WITHOUT creating a record. Returns the full tax breakdown (federal, state, FICA, FUTA), net pay, and employer costs. Cross-state employees: each employee's result includes a `reciprocity` field when their work/residence states have a reciprocal agreement — applied=true means the work state's income tax was suppressed under the employer's certificate attestation (set up in the NannyKeeper app on the employee's profile); applied=false names the certificate still to collect. Mileage and other reimbursements go in reimbursements, the same lines run_payroll takes. Use this to validate your request before calling run_payroll. Same parameters as run_payroll. Requires a Starter+ subscription. pay_date is optional. When omitted, the server picks the earliest valid business day on or after pay_period_end, allowing for ACH submission lead time, and echoes it back in the response. v1.5.0: if pay_date is more than 5 business days in the future, the response includes is_estimated=true — those numbers will be recomputed at fire time if the user schedules. Get employee_id from list_employees. employer_id is optional: leave it out and the API uses the household your API key belongs to (pass it only when one account manages several households).

bonus.description: Bonus amount in dollars for this period

employee_id.description: Employee UUID. Get it from list_employees.

employer_id.description: Optional. Leave it out to use the household your API key belongs to. Pass it only when one account manages several households; list_employees returns it.

other_earnings.description: Other earnings in dollars for this period

pay_date.description: Date employee is paid (YYYY-MM-DD), on or after pay_period_end. Optional: if omitted, the server picks the earliest valid business day on or after pay_period_end.

pay_frequency.description: How often the employee is paid

pay_period_end.description: End of pay period in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., 2026-04-13)

pay_period_start.description: Start of pay period in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., 2026-04-07)

regular_hours.description: Regular hours worked this period (e.g., 40 for a full week)

reimbursements.description: Optional. Up to 10 reimbursements paid with this paycheck: mileage, transit, parking or other. NannyKeeper adds them to net pay, outside gross pay, without calculating tax on them; a transit or parking line over the monthly limit, or in a year whose limit NannyKeeper does not hold, comes back with a warning. Mileage example: [{"type":"mileage","miles":42,"amount":0}].

amount.description: Dollars. For a mileage line with miles, send 0: NannyKeeper prices the miles and ignores this amount.

description.description: Optional. What it was for, as the pay stub should show it.

miles.description: Mileage lines: the miles driven this pay period.

rate_per_mile.description: Optional, mileage lines only. Leave it out and NannyKeeper uses the IRS business mileage rate it holds for the pay period and pay date. If it holds none for that year, the payroll is refused with mileage_rate_unavailable; pass the rate your agreement sets to continue.

voluntary_set_aside.description: Override or skip the employee's voluntary post-tax set-aside rule for this paycheck only. The recurring rule itself is configured via the dashboard. Omit this field to apply the rule normally.

amount.description: Override the rule's computed amount for this paycheck only

skip.description: Skip the active set-aside rule for this paycheck only

name: preview_payroll
